def recursive_func(val, level, base_powers):
    val = abs(val)
    if val % base_powers[level] == 0:
        return (val // base_powers[level]) * level
    q = val // base_powers[level]
    res1 = q * level + recursive_func(val - q * base_powers[level], level - 1, base_powers)
    res2 = (q + 1) * level + recursive_func((q + 1) * base_powers[level] - val, level - 1, base_powers)
    return min(res1, res2)

def execute():
    base_powers = [0] * 20
    base_powers[1] = 1
    for i in range(17):
        base_powers[i + 2] = base_powers[i + 1] * 10 + 1
    input_value = int(input())
    print(recursive_func(input_value, 18, base_powers))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    execute()
